#!/bin/bash

# PropScan Uninstall Script

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_status() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Installation paths
VENV_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/propscan-venv"
INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/propscan"
BIN_FILE="$HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
DESKTOP_FILE="$HOME/.local/share/applications/propscan.desktop"

remove_venv_installation() {
    print_status "Checking for virtual environment installation..."
    
    if [ -d "$VENV_DIR" ]; then
        print_status "Removing virtual environment at $VENV_DIR..."
        rm -rf "$VENV_DIR"
        print_success "Virtual environment removed."
        return 0
    else
        print_status "No virtual environment installation found."
        return 1
    fi
}

remove_simple_installation() {
    print_status "Checking for simple installation..."
    
    if [ -d "$INSTALL_DIR" ]; then
        print_status "Removing installation directory at $INSTALL_DIR..."
        rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR"
        print_success "Installation directory removed."
        return 0
    else
        print_status "No simple installation found."
        return 1
    fi
}

remove_pip_installation() {
    print_status "Checking for pip installation..."
    
    # Check if propscan is installed via pip
    if python3 -m pip show propscan &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Removing propscan installed via pip..."
        python3 -m pip uninstall -y propscan
        print_success "Pip installation removed."
        return 0
    else
        print_status "No pip installation found."
        return 1
    fi
}

remove_wrapper_script() {
    print_status "Removing wrapper script..."
    
    if [ -f "$BIN_FILE" ]; then
        rm -f "$BIN_FILE"
        print_success "Wrapper script removed from $BIN_FILE"
    else
        print_status "No wrapper script found."
    fi
}

remove_desktop_entry() {
    print_status "Removing desktop entry..."
    
    if [ -f "$DESKTOP_FILE" ]; then
        rm -f "$DESKTOP_FILE"
        print_success "Desktop entry removed from $DESKTOP_FILE"
    else
        print_status "No desktop entry found."
    fi
}

cleanup_path_modifications() {
    print_status "Checking for PATH modifications in ~/.bashrc..."
    
    if [ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ]; then
        # Check if our PATH modification exists
        if grep -q "# Added by PropScan installer" "$HOME/.bashrc"; then
            print_warning "Found PATH modifications in ~/.bashrc"
            print_status "You may want to manually remove these lines from ~/.bashrc:"
            echo "  # Added by PropScan installer"
            echo "  export PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\""
            echo
            print_status "Or run this command to remove them automatically:"
            echo "  sed -i '/# Added by PropScan installer/,+1d' ~/.bashrc"
        else
            print_status "No PATH modifications found in ~/.bashrc"
        fi
    fi
}

remove_user_dependencies() {
    print_status "Checking for user-installed dependencies..."
    
    # List of dependencies that might have been installed
    DEPS=("click" "tabulate" "colorama")
    
    for dep in "${DEPS[@]}"; do
        if python3 -m pip show "$dep" &> /dev/null; then
            read -p "Remove user-installed dependency '$dep'? [y/N]: " -n 1 -r
            echo
            if [[ $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
                python3 -m pip uninstall -y "$dep"
                print_success "Removed dependency: $dep"
            else
                print_status "Keeping dependency: $dep"
            fi
        fi
    done
}

show_completion_message() {
    print_success "PropScan uninstallation completed!"
    echo
    print_status "The following items have been removed:"
    echo "  - PropScan executable and wrapper script"
    echo "  - Desktop entry"
    echo "  - Installation directories"
    echo "  - Virtual environment (if present)"
    echo
    print_status "You may want to:"
    echo "  - Remove any PATH modifications from your shell configuration"
    echo "  - Restart your terminal or run: source ~/.bashrc"
    echo
}

confirm_uninstall() {
    echo "PropScan Uninstall Script"
    echo "========================="
    echo
    print_warning "This will remove PropScan and all its components from your system."
    echo
    read -p "Are you sure you want to continue? [y/N]: " -n 1 -r
    echo
    if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
        print_status "Uninstallation cancelled."
        exit 0
    fi
    echo
}

main() {
    confirm_uninstall
    
    # Track if any installation was found
    FOUND_INSTALLATION=false
    
    # Try to remove different types of installations
    if remove_venv_installation; then
        FOUND_INSTALLATION=true
    fi
    
    if remove_simple_installation; then
        FOUND_INSTALLATION=true
    fi
    
    if remove_pip_installation; then
        FOUND_INSTALLATION=true
    fi
    
    # Always try to remove these regardless of installation type
    remove_wrapper_script
    remove_desktop_entry
    
    # Optional cleanup
    cleanup_path_modifications
    
    # Ask about dependencies only if we found an installation
    if [ "$FOUND_INSTALLATION" = true ]; then
        echo
        read -p "Remove user-installed Python dependencies? [y/N]: " -n 1 -r
        echo
        if [[ $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
            remove_user_dependencies
        fi
    else
        print_warning "No PropScan installation found on this system."
        print_status "Cleaned up any remaining files."
    fi
    
    show_completion_message
}

main "$@"
